title: Dreamweaver
subtitle: Remote bridge, layered config, workshop links, and agent spirit (V3) flags.

bridge.title: WebSocket & SSE
bridge.desc: Connect SDK or automation to the gateway event stream.
bridge.sse: Server-Sent Events (token auth, same as MCP bridge):
bridge.auth: Send Authorization: Bearer <gateway token> for SSE when the gateway requires a token.

layers.title: Config merge order
layers.desc: DreamWeaver and related settings combine from lowest to highest precedence.

alchemy.title: Alchemy
alchemy.desc: Package build and publish flows use the CLI and admin packages UI.
alchemy.cli: Use goclaw packages commands from your project; see docs for publish and verify.

spirit.title: Spirit settings
spirit.desc: Per-agent V3 capability flags (pipeline, memory, retrieval, self-evolution).
spirit.hint: Choose an agent to view and toggle V3 flags.

wizard.title: Workshop wizard
wizard.subtitle: Step-by-step: choose a goal, prepare your environment, jump to Skills or Agents, then publish to the marketplace.

prepare.cli: Install the goclaw CLI and authenticate to your gateway if you use remote publish.
prepare.workspace: Use a project folder with .goclaw and valid SKILL.md or agent JSON for validation.
prepare.token: Set GOCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN when using Publisher → remote upload or marketplace push.

done.hint: Use Marketplace to install packages or publish after your files pass local validation.

s1.label: Goal
s1.title: What are you building?
s1.desc: Pick one path. You can change it before finishing.

s2.label: Prepare
s2.title: Prerequisites
s2.desc: Check these before creating or uploading artifacts.

s3.label: Create
s3.title: Go to the right screen
s3.desc: Open Skills or Agents to create content; Marketplace lists published packages.

s4.label: Done
s4.title: Next steps
s4.desc: Publish with the CLI when ready, or browse the marketplace.
